Name: ValleyArms
Author: ddedde03
Description:
This mod adds pistols, assault rifles, and a railgun to Stardew Valley.
Guns, ammunition, and attachments can be crafted at a dedicated Gunsmith Workbench.
Floors 198 and 199 of the Skull Cavern are replaced with custom boss areas. Defeating the boss drops a material needed to craft the railgun. The boss can only be defeated once.
In single-player, time pauses when you enter the boss areas. In multiplayer, time pauses and the battle begins once all connected players have entered the boss room. Multiplayer functionality has not been tested in an actual session.
To disable the boss encounter, set
[code]BossDefeated[/code]to
[code]true[/code]in the config file.
[list]
[*]Disabling the encounter prevents you from obtaining the required material, so the railgun cannot be crafted through normal gameplay.[/*]
[/list]
